As Apple (AAPL) Shares Declined, Holder Spears Abacus Advisors Has Lowered Stake; Paradigm Financial Advisors Continues to Hold Holding in Qualcomm (QCOM)
May 25, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Spears Abacus Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Spears Abacus Advisors Llc sold 4,676 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 188,283 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $31.86 million, down from 192,959 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Spears Abacus Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $930.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.59% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $189.26. About 10.83 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Paradigm Financial Advisors Llc increased its stake in Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) by 10.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Paradigm Financial Advisors Llc bought 7,952 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.28% with the market. The institutional investor held 82,928 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.31 million, up from 74,976 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Paradigm Financial Advisors Llc who had been investing in Qualcomm Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.61% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $59.44. About 5.78M shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has declined 3.21% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.76% the S&P500.
